name: Vocal Remover
description: Ultimate Vocal Remover's MDX-Net separation, running entirely in the sandbox. Give it a song and it gives you back the singing and the backing as separate files — and, if you ask, splits the vocal again into lead and backing. It is SLOW: the model listens in six-second pieces, roughly the length of the track on a device with a GPU and several times that on the processor alone, so try thirty seconds first. UVR's own model weights (120 MB) arrive once as a hash-pinned download and stay on this computer. Nothing is ever uploaded — the app has no network of its own.
